item.text: [{"task_id":"f1bcbc2c","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    wall = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    gate = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    fill = int(round(params['colors'][3]))","    moves = []","    for pair in params['moves']:","        moves.append((int(round(pair[0])), int(round(pair[1]))))","    top = int(round(params['start'][0]))","    h, w = grid.shape","    out = grid.copy()","    if top < 0 or top >= h:","        return out","    allowed = grid == bg","    left = moves[2]","    right = moves[3]","    for r in range(h):","        for c in range(w):","            if grid[r, c] == gate:","                a, b = r + left[0], c + left[1]","                x, y = r + right[0], c + right[1]","                if 0 <= a < h and 0 <= b < w and 0 <= x < h and 0 <= y < w:","                    if grid[a, b] == wall and grid[x, y] == wall:","                        allowed[r, c] = True","    queue = []","    seen = set()","    for c in range(w):","        a, b = top + left[0], c + left[1]","        x, y = top + right[0], c + right[1]","        if 0 <= a < h and 0 <= b < w and 0 <= x < h and 0 <= y < w:","            if grid[top, c] == bg and grid[a, b] == wall and grid[x, y] == wall:","                queue.append((top, c))","                seen.add((top, c))","    while queue:","        r, c = queue.pop()","        out[r, c] = fill","        for dr, dc in moves:","            a, b = r + dr, c + dc","            if 0 <= a < h and 0 <= b < w:","                if allowed[a, b] and (a, b) not in seen:","                    seen.add((a, b))","                    queue.append((a, b))","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[4],"moves":[4,2],"start":[1]},"params":{"colors":[0,7,9,8],"moves":[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]],"start":[0]},"rationale":"Fill the corridor from its top entrance with blue. A maroon gate permits passage along a vertical corridor, where yellow walls flank it horizontally; otherwise it blocks passage and remains maroon. Flooding the reachable corridor reproduces all four demonstrations."}]
